title: Is it just me?  Please tell me its not just me #Broadway #SweeneyTodd...
transcript: I don't know if this is a hot take or not, but Sweeney Todd just released their “Not While I'm Around” recording and I don't love it? And that's not to say that like Gaten is bad, like he sounds really good and like vocally he is hitting all the notes, but it just sounds so artificial feeling . Like I think back to seeing that performance live, and it just felt so raw and emotionally driven and like you felt a lot of empathy for Toby in that moment. But when I listen to it on the cast recording, I just feel nothing. Like it feels really hollow and like overly polished. And this is definitely not a problem that only the Sweeney Todd cast recording has. (This is something that has plagued a lot of modern cast recordings.) But I don't know, it just kind of sucks. Like I feel bad that this is the version of Gaten’s performance that has been immortalized. Because in my opinion, I don't think it's a good representation of his performance.
